title: Migrate legacy reporting tables to a normalized schema
description: The reporting-platform database has three denormalized tables that duplicate data from core-api and have drifted out of sync. Migrate to a normalized schema with foreign keys back to the source of truth, without downtime for the nightly reporting job.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Plan: expand-contract migration. Step 1 add new normalized tables and dual-write. Step 2 backfill with a management command in batches of 5k rows. Step 3 cut reads over. Step 4 drop old tables after a two-week bake period.

comments.author: data-eng
comments.text: Batching sounds right, just make sure the backfill command is resumable in case it gets killed mid-run.

implementation_notes: Used Django migrations for schema changes and a separate idempotent management command (tracked via a `backfill_progress` table keyed by last-migrated id) for the data backfill, so it could be safely re-run after interruption. Dual-write was implemented via a Django signal on the legacy models during the transition window.
resolution: Backfill completed over 3 nights during low-traffic windows. Reads cut over to the normalized tables with no reported discrepancies. Legacy tables dropped after the two-week bake period with no incidents.
